# `em select repository add`

- **Usage:** `em select repository add <NAME> <LOCATION>`

Register an existing local repository

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — Repository name
- **`<LOCATION>`** — Existing local path to the repository

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
